senses.gloss: (b. h.; v. סָרַט) to scratch, wound, v. סָרַט; esp. to wound one’s body in mourning.
units: <cite ref="Mishnah Makkot 3:5">Macc. III, 5</cite> <he>השׂוֹרֵט שריטה וכ׳</he> he who makes one incision for a dead person.

<cite ref="Mishnah Makkot 3:5">Ib.</cite> <he>ש׳ שריטה וכ׳</he> if a person makes one incision for five dead or five incisions for one dead person. Ib. 20ᵇ <he>יכול אפי׳ ש׳ על ביתו וכ׳</he> you may think that one is guilty even if he cuts himself for his house that fell in &c.; a. e.

senses.gloss: <cite ref="U01950">same</cite>. Ib. 21ᵃ <he>המְשָׂרֵט בכלי</he> if one wounds himself with an instrument (instead of with his nails); a. fr.
